body:
🟠🐛 **Fix · bug: role="img" hides the size bar's '% lighter' and GitHub-limit text from screen readers**

The size bar section has `role="img"`. With that role its children are presentational, so assistive tech reads only the `aria-label`. That label is `meterLabel` ("Your recording {from}, the copy {to}", en.json:824). The visible text in `parts` (lines 326-333), "{percent}% lighter" / "Not lighter" and "under the 10 MB limit" / "over GitHub's 10 MB free-plan limit", is never announced. For GitHub, whether the file fits the 10 MB free-plan limit is the one fact this card exists to give, and screen-reader users don't get it. Put `role="img"` and the label on the decorative bar only (line 352, which is currently `aria-hidden`) and leave the text labels readable, or add `parts.join(", ")` to the aria-label.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Radio groups have no arrow-key navigation or roving tabindex**

The destination rows here, and the 1440p/4K and Fill/Fit segments in destination-detail.tsx (lines 259-275 and 391-405), use `role="radiogroup"`/`role="radio"` on plain buttons. Every radio is a separate Tab stop, and arrow keys do nothing. Screen readers announce these as radio groups, and users expect the WAI-ARIA radio pattern: one Tab stop, with arrows moving the selection. `isPrimaryEnter` in prepare-page.tsx:272 already treats these buttons as radios for Enter, so you could add arrow-key handling with `tabIndex={selected === d ? 0 : -1}`. The other option is to drop the radio roles and use `aria-pressed`/`aria-current`.

🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: The "does not re-select" check passes even without preventDefault**

In jsdom, `fireEvent.keyDown(youtube, { key: "Enter" })` only sends a keydown event. jsdom never fires the click that a real browser fires on Enter over a `<button>`. So `aria-checked` stays "false" whether or not `prepare-page.tsx:215` calls `event.preventDefault()`, and this test would still pass if that line were removed. To test the behaviour, assert on the event itself: `fireEvent.keyDown` returns `false` when the default was prevented, so `expect(fireEvent.keyDown(youtube, { key: "Enter" })).toBe(false)` would do it. Otherwise, reword the test name so it doesn't claim the row isn't re-selected.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Enter listener on the whole document reacts to elements outside the page and to non-native controls**

The listener sits on `document`, so it sees every Enter in the window, not just Enter pressed inside the Prepare screen. `isPrimaryEnter` (line 263) only skips form fields, links and `<button>` elements, so Enter on other focusable controls still starts a copy. In this repo those include `div role="button"` (`export-status-cards.tsx:179`, `video-card.tsx:56`), `role="tab"` and `role="option"`. There is also an ordering problem: `onboarding-overlay.tsx:62-74` handles Enter in a `window` listener, and an event bubbling up reaches `document` before `window`. If onboarding is open over this page (it opens on first launch, and Settings can replay it) and focus is not on its Continue button, one Enter would both advance onboarding and start an encode. One option is to only act when the event target is inside the screen root, or is `document.body`.

🟠🧹 **Fix · cleanup: New key `prepare.sizeBarTitle` is never used**

`sizeBarTitle` ("Your recording and the copy, on one scale") is new in this PR, but nothing under `apps/kaipu-record/src` reads it. `SizeBarCard` (`destination-detail.tsx:313-359`) has no visible title and labels itself with `meterLabel` instead. Every other key this PR adds is used by `destination-list.tsx` or `destination-detail.tsx`. The doc's note about keeping old keys for now (`prepare-screen.md:131-132`) covers the dropped keys, not new ones. Either show it as the card's kicker, like the other cards' `h2`, or remove it from `en.json` and `es.json` (line 780 in both).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Obsolete: `prepare.sizeBarTitle` was removed from `en.json` and `es.json` in #456 (merge `8f3eea4a` on `feature/niw2-586-background-toasts`), and no key by that name exists at the top of the stack.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Out of scope here: at the top of the stack (`pages/export/export-page.tsx`, after #467), the Export screen has no non-native `role="button"`/`tab`/`option` controls, and onboarding only opens on first launch or from Settings, never over this screen. So no Enter reaches this listener from outside the page today. Noted as a follow-up: scope `isPrimaryEnter` to the screen root.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`8d32e282`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/8d32e282f15910c94d270d43b203dfa1dcc5d1a8) on #471 (top of the stack): the size card is plain text now (no `role="img"`/`aria-label`), so the verdict — fits / over the 10 MB limit, N% lighter — is read out; a test asserts no image role wraps it.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`53179191`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/53179191315c6fd834d86800db792330b4406b75) on #471 (top of the stack): the 1440p / 4K and Fill / Fit groups now have a roving tabindex and move their choice with the arrow keys, focus following; the destination cards were already fixed by #467 (`destination-row.tsx`).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`53179191`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/53179191315c6fd834d86800db792330b4406b75) on #471 (top of the stack): both Enter tests now assert `fireEvent.keyDown(...)` returns `false`; removing the `preventDefault()` turns them red (checked).
